observation_summary: The createCopy method returns a TimeSeries object with incorrect min/max Y values when the copied range does not encompass the full range of the original series.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the TimeSeries.createCopy method clones the original object, which includes copying the cached min and max Y values from the source series. When a subset of the data is copied, these cached values are not recalculated or reset, leading to incorrect min/max values in the new series. The fix explicitly resets the minY and maxY fields to Double.NaN in the cloned object, forcing a recalculation based on the new data subset.
